question: A sum of money amounts to Rs. 13,380 after 3 years and to Rs. 20,070 after 6 years at compound interest compounded annually. Find the sum.
solution:

A sum of money amounts to Rs. 13,380 after 3 years and to Rs. 20,070 after 6 years at compound interest compounded annually.

Let the principal sum be P and the rate of interest be R.

Using the compound interest formula:

Amount after n years A = P × (1 + (R)/(100))^n
